c1.note: August 13, 2026 release names Grocers Supply in the C&S family of companies.

c2.note: August 2026 release lists Hansen Distribution Group in the family.

c3.note: August 2026 release lists Davidson Specialty Foods; careers page uses the longer name.

c4.note: SpartanNash is named in the August 2026 release and acquired in Sept 2025.

c5.note: Sept 2025 release and careers page name FreshKo; the Aug 2026 description omits it, so current status is less certain.

c7.note: The Aug 2026 description omits FreshKo, which makes its current status uncertain.

c8.note: The Sept 22, 2025 release lists FreshKo and The Davidson Specialty Food Group. Davidson is still in the current list under a shortened name, so the claim that it is absent is misleading.

c9.note: The family page excerpt links Davidson, Hansen, Grocers Supply and SpartanNash, consistent with the August 2026 release.

c10.note: The page links the four brands plus the Military Distribution page, so five entries fits.

c11.note: The military distribution page is listed under the family and SpartanNash site lists SpartanNash Military Distribution.

c12.note: Release dated September 22, 2025 announces completion of the SpartanNash acquisition.

c13.note: Davidson's own site states it became a wholly owned C&S subsidiary in 2016.

c14.note: The release says FreshKO would operate under its brand as a wholly-owned subsidiary; this is historical and current status is unconfirmed.

c17.note: Piggly Wiggly Midwest's own site says it operates as part of C&S, though that does not establish a legal subsidiary.

c18.note: Piggly Wiggly, LLC's site says it is an affiliate of C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC.

c19.note: C&S boilerplate matches the claim word for word.

c20.note: C&S calls these banners of its corporate-run stores; the sources do not say they are separate legal subsidiaries, so the caveat is accurate.

c21.note: Grocery Dive says SpartanNash operates Family Fare and Martin's banners since the merger with C&S, which is consistent with the claim; the VG's and D&W attribution is plausible and the indirect-ownership framing is reasonable.

c22.note: The August 13, 2026 C&S release announces a proposed transaction to become majority owner of Winn-Dixie.

c23.note: The release says close is expected in early 2027, so it was not complete as of the run date; no sources show earlier closing.

c25.note: The release states C&S, as part of a consortium, acquired Winn-Dixie from ALDI U.S. in 2025.

c27.note: The release confirms the consortium purchase, so C&S holds a stake (the release implies it is not yet majority); the minority label is inferred from the proposed majority deal.

c28.note: C&S uses 'family of companies' with 'including', and no legal-entity subsidiary list appears in the sources.

c30.note: The September 22, 2025 release states the combined company has more than 30,000 team members and almost 60 distribution centers.

c31.note: The completion release states the combined company serves close to 10,000 independent retail locations plus military commissaries and exchanges; this is context about scale rather than a list of subsidiaries.

c32.note: The boilerplate names the family (Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, FreshKo, Davidson, SpartanNash) and says 60 distribution centers nationwide. Variant D's wording matches the release; the claim's own wording omits 'products and services' but is not substantively different.

c33.note: The release says 'Established in 1918, C&S had its start as a supplier to independent grocery stores' and cswg.com says 'Headquartered in Keene, N.H.'; this is background on the company, not a list of subsidiaries.

c6.note: The saved Family of Companies page lists only Davidson, Hansen, Grocers Supply, SpartanNash and Military, with no FreshKO. The older acquisition release called it a wholly-owned subsidiary, so its absence now fits with it having been folded into another unit, though that part is only speculation.

c5.note: Both cited sources name FreshKo Produce Services in the C&S family of companies. The careers page lists it today with Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, The Davidson Specialty Food Group and SpartanNash. The Sept 22, 2025 SpartanNash completion release has it in the About C&S section. Caveat
